# Public Health Environmental Surveillance Evaluation Framework {.hero-title .unlisted}
:::

<!-- HOME PAGE TEXT -->

::: justify-text
The Public Health Environmental Surveillance Evaluation Framework (PHES-EF) is an international consensus study developing a comprehensive framework to evaluate public health environmental surveillance systems. We use wastewater-based surveillance as our primary example.<br>

<b>Our approach:</b> We use the Delphi method—an iterative survey process using structured feedback and expert anonymity to build consensus. A diverse panel of global experts will help us create an evidence-informed framework for assessing surveillance system performance. [Learn more about the e-Delphi study.](delphi.qmd)

<b>Next steps:</b> We are finalizing the list of candidate items this fall. Registration for e-Delphi panellists opens in January 2027, Round 1 of the survey runs in March 2027 and Round 2 closes in May 2027.

::: cta-box
<b>Want to participate?</b> [Contact us](contact.qmd)
:::
:::
